title: Answer: find how brain processes cause consciousness, and what else could

statements.text: What can be checked is neuroscientific: which brain processes cause consciousness and how, and whether systems built from another chemistry have the same causal powers, an empirical question like photosynthesis without chlorophyll.

sources.quote: That is an empirical question, rather like the question whether photosynthesis can be done by something with a chemistry different from that of chlorophyll.
